items: 【Nightstand with Charging Station】This bedside table with charging station features 2 AC outlets, 1 USB port, and 1 Type-C port with a 4.9ft power cord, so you can easily charge your phone, tablet, or even smart glasses right beside your bed or sofa. No more hunting for wall sockets — everything’s within reach

【Night Stand with 2 Drawers] A compact end table with surprisingly large storage! Thetabletop fits your lamp, books, or coffee cup easily, while 2 fabric drawers and an open shelf keep remotes, chargers, or bedtime reads neatly tucked away. Finally, a nightstand that actually holds everything you need

【Durable Build with Stylish Details】Built to last with scratch-resistant, waterproof engineered wood and a sturdy powder-coated steel frame. The wood-grain finish adds warmth to your space, while the square metal handles and X-shaped side design give it that clean, modern charm. Beautiful and reliable — just how bedside table should be

【Perfect for Small Spaces】Sized at 15.7" × 11.8" × 23.6" , this little couch side table fits anywhere — beside your bed, next to your couch, or even as a printer stand in your home office. The adjustable feet keep it stable on uneven floors. A true multitasker: nightstand, end table, or mini sidekick — your choice

【Quick Assembly & Multiple Color Choices】Available in 6 colors to match any décor. Comes with clear instructions, labeled parts, and tools for a hassle-free setup in minutes. You’ll be enjoying your new nightstand with drawers before your next cup of coffee is ready
